dataset.name: Open Power System Data — Household Data

interpolation.policy: selected E7 source feeds must be non-interpolated

selection.policy: earliest contiguous valid non-interpolated-selected-feed cumulative window yielding consecutive 15-minute intervals in source order

transformation.interval_timestamp_convention: later/end timestamp of the two cumulative readings
transformation.method: first difference of consecutive 15-minute cumulative readings
transformation.monotonic_counter_reset_policy: counters must be monotonic nondecreasing; any decrease resets the candidate window without absolute value, clamping, or tolerance
